instruction: Please help enable the 'Use dark theme for the GIMP user interface' option.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling the dark theme preference option via Edit > Preferences > Interface > Theme. The evaluator checks the gimprc config file for (prefer-dark-theme yes) using the existing check_config_status metric. Similar difficulty to the original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: enabling GIMP dark theme option
Getter logic is correct: reads gimprc config file from ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc
Metric logic is correct: check_config_status properly parses GIMP config format and checks for (prefer-dark-theme yes)
Expected value is semantically correct: key='prefer-dark-theme' value='yes' matches GIMP's actual config format
Postconfig is necessary and appropriate: closes GIMP with Ctrl+Q to flush config changes to disk
Parameter handling is correct: metric receives rules dict directly without accessing nested 'rules' key
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires
Runtime feasibility: all components will work correctly during actual execution
